geometry: equal-area cells on the density COGs' own WGS84 Lambert Azimuthal Equal Area lattice at 25000 m (#87). Cells are square and 25 km on both axes everywhere; the 25 km tier is an exact 5x5 aggregate of the 5 km tier. lat/lon are the WGS84 coordinates of the projected cell centre.
land_mask: Union of supported 5 km child cells in the final aggregated all-taxa stack
discover_method: NaN-aware mean of the 5 km under-sampling scores, including their climate ordering
staleness_method: iNaturalist recent-vs-all-time density (ca_staleness.csv); inverse-density proxy where absent.
ramps: National ramps fitted on native 25 km fields and applied at 5 km; displayed 25 km axes aggregate the scored children
resample_note: 25 km axes and travel are means of supported 5 km child values; n_train sums child counts

axes_status.discover: REAL (under-sampling rank from iNaturalist density COG)
axes_status.conservation: REAL (COSEWIC/SARA at-risk richness, CAN-SAR x GBIF; 0.25-deg source)
axes_status.staleness: REAL (iNaturalist recent vs all-time density; 0.25-deg source)
axes_status.n_train: REAL-proxy (sum of rounded 5 km density-derived record counts)

density_vintage: iNaturalist (Biodiversite Quebec) inat_canada_heatmaps; n_train sums the rounded 5 km child counts
popup_source: final grid_25000m stacks, aggregated from 5 km; float32 axes retained
